description: Feature-level leakage audit for ML-05. Option 1: March-May 2026 features -> June 2026 target.

window_alignment.evidence: Feature window ends 2026-05-31, label window starts 2026-06-01. No overlap. Verified via DuckDB MAX(report_date) on 2026-03 partition.

label_derived_features.evidence: Label is_declining_june built from daily gsc_impressions (June < 0.8 * May). trend_direction and trend_pct are starter-only, not in warehouse. No label-derived column in feature set.

id_exclusion.evidence: client_hash_id, content_hash_id, query_hash_id are pseudonymous IDs. Used for grouping/joining/splitting only. Not in feature set.

product_flags.evidence: dim_content has no health_score, priority_score, action_type, refresh_tier, or any product decision flag. Verified via column name scan.

grain_probe.evidence: 0 duplicate (report_date, client_hash_id, content_hash_id) groups in 2026-03 partition (9,841,378 rows).

join_cardinality.evidence: fact->dim_content is many-to-one: 331,437 distinct content in 2026-03 <= 519,606 dim rows. fact->dim_clients: 55 <= 104.

three_valued_flags.evidence: ga4_data_available is 3-valued (TRUE/FALSE/NULL). 2,397,428 NULL rows in 2026-06. Filter with IS TRUE / IS NOT TRUE, never = FALSE or NOT.

avg_position_zero_sentinel.evidence: 163,189 / 9,841,378 (1.7%) rows have gsc_avg_position = 0.0 in 2026-03. 0 means no data, not rank zero.

query_90d_window_overlap.evidence: query_90d fixed window 2026-04-02 -> 2026-06-30. impressions_last30 (June) and avg_position_last30 (June) are EXCLUDED as leakage. Only impressions_prev30, clicks_prev30, avg_position_prev30 (May) are safe features.

impressions_prev30.evidence: covers May (prev 30 of query window), ends before June label

avg_position_prev30.evidence: covers May; NULL when no impressions in May

content_total_impressions_90d.evidence: describes full query window (Apr 2-Jun 30); use as volume context, not predictive feature
